sentences.en: "That was a terrible miss!" cried the commentators.
sentences.zh: “那真是一个糟糕的失误！”评论员们喊道。

sentences.en: Some commentators have observed that we are living in a post-truth age.
sentences.zh: 一些评论员认为，我们现在生活在一个后真相时代。

sentences.en: Many commentators regard Obama as a centrist.
sentences.zh: 许多评论家认为奥巴马是一个中间派。
